summary: Regression testing completed: all backend tests pass, including sanitized community responses, recovery password reset, refresh rotation, authenticated WebSocket rejection/broadcast, persistence, and status APIs. Browser login, persisted workspace, management actions, audit panel, messaging, voice controls, logout, mobile layout, and console smoke passed.

critical.issue: Code review finding: action=kick only deletes a ban record and does not remove the target membership, so expulsar has no effect.

integration_issues.issue: The add voice-room button has no onClick handler; only the seeded lounge opens.

action_items: Fix moderation kick to remove membership or otherwise enforce the expelled state.
Wire add-voice-room to a supported room creation flow, or remove/disable the control until implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: moderate(action=kick) currently deletes bans rather than removing membership, making the requested expulsar behavior ineffective.
App.js emits an unhandled React hook dependency warning in VoiceRoom cleanup; capture the peer map locally before cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_ users, communities, channels, recovery records, and WebSocket sessions through public APIs; no seeded account was modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core auth, persistence, management create/invite/audit, authenticated WebSocket, message rendering, voice modal mute/leave, logout, mobile overflow, and console smoke are covered. Re-test moderation kick and voice-room creation after fixes; submit moderation action with a real target membership.
rca of the issue: Previous ObjectId serialization, missing recovery verification, refresh rotation, and anonymous WebSocket issues are resolved and regression-tested. Remaining moderation issue is a business-logic branch: kick and unban share the same ban deletion path, with no membership deletion or expelled-state record. The voice add control is rendered without an event handler, so it cannot create a room. No APIs were mocked.
